story.text: Japan beat Germany 2-1 in the Group Stage of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Germany had more of the ball (74 percent to 26 percent), and Germany also created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (3.10 to 1.50). The goals came from İlkay Gündoğan at 32:35 (penalty), Ritsu Doan at 74:46 and Takuma Asano at 82:42.
